description: Layout templates for the standard slide pipeline. Each template is a complete HTML document with FISSO (fixed structure) and ADATTA (adaptable content) zones. Templates are preset-agnostic — they use z-* grid/layer classes from _theme.css and deco-* decoration classes from _preset.css.

cover_hero.description: Full-bleed background image with centered title overlay and optional kicker. Best for impactful opening slides.
cover_hero.variants: dark base (default), light base for minimal covers
cover_hero.advice: Always pair with a strong hero image or generated background. Title should be 4-8 words.

content_two_col.description: Header with kicker + title, then two equal columns for text, lists, or cards. The workhorse template.
content_two_col.variants: surface base (default), dark base for emphasis
content_two_col.advice: Each column can hold different content types: text + cards, text + list, image + text. Keep both columns balanced in visual weight.

data_metrics.description: Header with kicker + title, then 2-4 large metric cards with stat values, descriptions, and icons.
data_metrics.variants: surface base (default), dark base for section data, accent base for emphasis
data_metrics.advice: Grid adapts: z-grid-split for 2 metrics, z-grid-thirds for 3, z-grid-quarters for 4. Each metric should have a stat value, label, and 1-line description.
